t: This is Bow Bus Garage, a bus depot in east London that began as a tram and trolleybus depot. The architect who designed it was Vincent Harris, often known as E. Vincent Harris. He was an English architect who designed several important public buildings in traditional styles. So this is a working garage, but one shaped by a man better known for civic buildings. Look at the frontage and the proportions with that in mind, and see how a place built for vehicles was given the care of a more formal design.
